input.rationale: The PR deletes setup.py and moves all packaging metadata into pyproject.toml. It also replaces `setup.py test` and `setup.py antlr` with bin/test, bin/doctest and `python -m` build modules. Anyone who builds or packages SymPy from source is affected, so the PR deserves an entry under `other`. Both entries are accurate. Candidate A tells users the practical result: setup.py commands no longer work, and they should use standard tools like pip. Candidate B only says that setup.py was replaced and cites a PEP, which leaves users to work out the effect themselves.
